questions.qtext: The regulation curve of a 1-φ transformer is shown below. Which point represents the regulation of a lightly capacitive load.
questions.solution:
For light capacitive load the power factor angle is leading but a small angle and hence high power factor.
Also for light capacitive load the voltage regulation is positive.

questions.qtext: The brush axis of a bipolar dc motor is rotated by 90°. The effect of this rotation on back emf Eb and the Torque Developed Td would be such that
questions.solution: The brushes in DC machine must lie along q-axis to collect maximum emf. So if they rotated by 90°, then they lie along d-axis and net induced emf will be zero. Similarly the angle b/w field and armature mmf will become zero so developed torque is also zero.
